blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229.8⟩ 乾熱滅菌 — 雙語教學版
blocks.en: USP ⟨1229.8⟩ Dry Heat Sterilization — Bilingual Training Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解乾熱滅菌（Dry Heat Sterilization）的原理：以熱空氣（≥160°C）作為傳熱介質，適用於耐熱但不適合蒸氣滅菌的物品
blocks.en: Understand the principle of dry heat sterilization: hot air (≥160°C) serves as the heat-transfer medium, suitable for heat-resistant items that cannot be steam sterilized

blocks.zh: 掌握 F<sub>H</sub> 致死率計算公式及其在製程控制中的應用（參考溫度 170°C，z 值 20°C）
blocks.en: Master the F<sub>H</sub> lethality formula and its use in process control (reference temperature 170°C, z-value 20°C)

blocks.zh: 區分乾熱滅菌隧道（Tunnel）與烘箱（Oven）的設計差異與各自的驗證要點
blocks.en: Distinguish the design differences between dry heat tunnels and ovens, and the validation focus of each

blocks.zh: 了解驗證四步驟：設備確效、空腔溫度分布、負載佈局、熱穿透 + 微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Understand the four validation steps: equipment qualification, empty chamber temperature distribution, load mapping, heat penetration + microbial challenge

blocks.zh: 認識生物指示劑 Bacillus atrophaeus（ATCC 9372）的選擇依據與使用方法
blocks.en: Know the rationale for selecting Bacillus atrophaeus (ATCC 9372) as the biological indicator and how to use it

blocks.zh: 理解乾熱滅菌與 ⟨1228.1⟩ 除熱原（Depyrogenation）的功能重疊與差異
blocks.en: Understand the functional overlap and differences between dry heat sterilization and depyrogenation under ⟨1228.1⟩

blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Dry Heat Sterilization（乾熱滅菌）：利用高溫空氣（而非蒸氣）殺死微生物的滅菌方法。適用對象包括：
blocks.en: Dry heat sterilization: a sterilization method that kills microorganisms with high-temperature air (rather than steam). Typical applications include:

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器 — 西林瓶（Vials）、安瓿、注射筒
blocks.en: Glass containers — vials, ampoules, syringes

blocks.zh: 不銹鋼部件 — 充填針頭、漏斗、管路接頭
blocks.en: Stainless steel parts — filling needles, funnels, tubing connectors

blocks.zh: 非水性液體 — 凡士林（Petrolatum）、礦物油
blocks.en: Non-aqueous liquids — petrolatum, mineral oil

blocks.zh: 粉體 — 原料藥粉末（需在乾燥狀態下滅菌）
blocks.en: Powders — active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) powders (must be sterilized in the dry state)

blocks.zh: 為什麼不用蒸氣？蒸氣滅菌（121°C, 15 min）效率更高，但會在物品表面留下水分。對於無水製劑的產品接觸面，即使微量殘留水分也可能破壞產品穩定性。
blocks.en: Why not use steam? Steam sterilization (121°C, 15 min) is more efficient, but it leaves moisture on the item surface. For product-contact surfaces used with anhydrous formulations, even a trace of residual moisture can compromise product stability.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 乾熱 vs 蒸氣 — 效率差異的物理根源：
blocks.en: Dry heat vs steam — the physical basis of the efficiency difference:

blocks.zh: 蒸氣滅菌利用水蒸氣的相變潛熱（Latent Heat）— 每克水蒸氣凝結時釋放約 2,260 焦耳的熱能，直接傳遞到物品表面。乾熱僅靠空氣的對流傳熱（Convection），空氣的比熱容（Specific Heat Capacity）遠低於水蒸氣，因此需要更高的溫度和更長的時間才能達到相同的致死效果。
blocks.en: Steam sterilization relies on the latent heat of phase change: each gram of steam releases about 2,260 joules as it condenses, delivering that energy directly to the item surface. Dry heat relies only on convective heat transfer through air, and the specific heat capacity of air is far lower than that of steam, so a higher temperature and a longer time are needed to achieve the same lethality.

blocks.zh: 最小負載 = 最差情境：這是一個容易被忽略的重點。在烘箱中，當負載量太少時，控制探頭可能偵測不到真實的腔內溫度變化（因為負載吸熱量不足），導致系統提前判定達標。驗證時必須同時測試最大和最小負載。
blocks.en: Minimum load = worst case: this point is easily overlooked. In an oven, when the load is too small, the control probe may not detect the true temperature change inside the chamber (because the load absorbs too little heat), so the system may judge the cycle complete too early. Validation must test both the maximum and the minimum load.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: Depyrogenation Tunnel 的雙重功能：在 CDMO 的無菌充填線上，除熱原隧道（Depyrogenation Tunnel）操作在 ≥250°C，遠超乾熱滅菌的溫度範圍（160–190°C）。這意味著除熱原隧道同時達成了滅菌 + 除熱原兩個目標。但本章 ⟨1229.8⟩ 聚焦於「乾熱滅菌」，而非除熱原 — 除熱原的驗證要求（≥3 log 內毒素降低）另見 ⟨1228.1⟩。
blocks.en: The dual function of a depyrogenation tunnel: on a CDMO aseptic filling line, the depyrogenation tunnel operates at ≥250°C, well above the dry heat sterilization range (160–190°C). This means the tunnel achieves sterilization + depyrogenation at the same time. However, ⟨1229.8⟩ focuses on dry heat sterilization, not depyrogenation; the validation requirements for depyrogenation (≥3 log endotoxin reduction) are covered separately in ⟨1228.1⟩.

blocks.zh: Sterilization Cycle Control — 滅菌週期控制
blocks.en: Sterilization Cycle Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 F<sub>H</sub> Value
blocks.en: Key Concepts: F<sub>H</sub> Value

blocks.zh: FH（Dry Heat Lethality）：乾熱滅菌的致死率度量，概念上類似蒸氣滅菌的 F0，但參考條件不同：
blocks.en: FH (dry heat lethality): the measure of lethality for dry heat sterilization. Conceptually it is similar to F0 for steam sterilization, but the reference conditions differ:

blocks.zh: z 值 = 20°C 的意義：溫度每升高 20°C，滅菌速率增加 10 倍。例如：在 190°C 操作 1 分鐘，等效於 170°C 操作 10 分鐘。
blocks.en: What a z-value of 20°C means: for every 20°C increase in temperature, the sterilization rate increases 10-fold. For example, 1 minute at 190°C is equivalent to 10 minutes at 170°C.

blocks.zh: F<sub>H</sub> Calculation — 致死率計算公式
blocks.en: F<sub>H</sub> Calculation — Lethality Formula

blocks.zh: 公式拆解 Formula Breakdown
blocks.en: Formula Breakdown

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：將整個乾熱滅菌週期（包含升溫和降溫階段）的每一分鐘溫度讀數，換算成等效的「170°C 分鐘數」，然後加總。
blocks.en: Core logic: the temperature reading for every minute of the entire dry heat cycle (including the heat-up and cool-down phases) is converted into equivalent "minutes at 170°C", and these are then summed.

blocks.zh: 計算範例：
blocks.en: Worked example:

Suppose the temperature in a given minute is T = 180°C:
  L = 10^((180 - 170) / 20) = 10^(0.5) = 3.16

Meaning: 1 minute at 180°C
     = 3.16 minutes at 170°C

Suppose the temperature in another minute is T = 160°C:
  L = 10^((160 - 170) / 20) = 10^(-0.5) = 0.316

Meaning: 1 minute at 160°C
     = only 0.316 minutes at 170°C

blocks.zh: 升溫 + 降溫段的貢獻：原文明確指出，FH 的計算涵蓋整個週期（heat-up and cool-down segments included）。這代表升溫和降溫階段也提供致死效果，可以計入總致死率。這對烘箱操作尤其重要，因為烘箱的升降溫時間可能占總週期的 40–60%。
blocks.en: Contribution of the heat-up and cool-down phases: the original text states explicitly that the FH calculation covers the entire cycle (heat-up and cool-down segments included). This means the heat-up and cool-down phases also deliver lethality and can be counted toward the total. This is especially important for oven operation, because the heat-up and cool-down times of an oven may account for 40–60% of the total cycle.

blocks.zh: 與除熱原 FH 的區別：⟨1228.1⟩ 除熱原使用相同的公式形式，但參考溫度為 250°C，z 值為 46.4°C，且驗收標準不同（≥3 log 內毒素降低）。不要混淆。
blocks.en: Difference from FH for depyrogenation: depyrogenation under ⟨1228.1⟩ uses the same form of formula, but the reference temperature is 250°C, the z-value is 46.4°C, and the acceptance criterion is different (≥3 log endotoxin reduction). Do not confuse the two.

blocks.zh: Validation of Dry Heat Sterilization — 乾熱滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Dry Heat Sterilization

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Overkill Method
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Overkill Method

blocks.zh: Overkill Method（過殺法）：乾熱滅菌幾乎都使用過殺法驗證，原因很簡單 — 被滅菌的物品（玻璃、金屬）耐熱性極高，完全能承受遠超最低需求的熱量。這與需要保護熱敏感產品的蒸氣滅菌形成對比。
blocks.en: Overkill method: dry heat sterilization is almost always validated using the overkill method, for a simple reason: the items being sterilized (glass, metal) are extremely heat resistant and can easily withstand far more heat than the minimum required. This contrasts with steam sterilization of heat-sensitive products, which must be protected from excess heat.

blocks.zh: 過殺法的三種證明方式：
blocks.en: Three ways to demonstrate overkill:

blocks.zh: 定義最低致死率 — 例如 FH ≥ 30 分鐘（在 170°C 等效）
blocks.en: Define a minimum lethality — for example, FH ≥ 30 minutes (170°C equivalent)

blocks.zh: 定義製程條件 — 例如 170°C / 120 分鐘
blocks.en: Define the process conditions — for example, 170°C / 120 minutes

blocks.zh: 確認最低 log 降低 — 例如 ≥12 log 生物指示劑殺滅（6 log BI population + 6 log safety margin）
blocks.en: Confirm a minimum log reduction — for example, ≥12 log kill of the biological indicator (6 log BI population + 6 log safety margin)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 用大砲打蚊子：過殺法的邏輯就像用大砲打蚊子 — 你可能只需要一把蒼蠅拍就夠了，但因為大砲不會傷到你的家具（耐熱物品），所以何不用大砲來確保萬無一失？這種「過度保障」的策略讓驗證文件大幅簡化，因為你不需要精確測定自然菌（Bioburden）的數量和抗性。
blocks.en: Using a cannon to kill a mosquito: the logic of overkill is like using a cannon to kill a mosquito. A fly swatter might be enough, but since the cannon will not damage your furniture (the heat-resistant items), why not use it to be absolutely safe? This "excess assurance" strategy greatly simplifies the validation documentation, because you do not need to determine the bioburden count and resistance precisely.

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification — 設備確效
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 IQ/OQ Framework
blocks.en: Key Concepts: IQ/OQ Framework

blocks.zh: 設備確效的目的：不是證明「滅菌有效」（那是 PQ 的工作），而是建立設備的操作基線（Baseline），確保設備安裝正確、運作符合設計規格。
blocks.en: Purpose of equipment qualification: it is not to prove that "sterilization is effective" (that is the job of PQ), but to establish the operating baseline of the equipment and ensure it is installed correctly and operates according to design specifications.

blocks.zh: IQ（Installation Qualification）：確認設備按照規格安裝 — 電源、管路連接、安全裝置、控制系統軟體版本等。
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification): confirms the equipment is installed according to specifications — power supply, piping connections, safety devices, control system software version, and so on.

blocks.zh: OQ（Operational Qualification）：確認設備在操作範圍內正常運作 — 溫度控制精度、加熱速率、風速均勻性、警報功能等。
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification): confirms the equipment operates properly across its operating range — temperature control accuracy, heating rate, air velocity uniformity, alarm functions, and so on.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要建立基線？設備確效產生的數據成為日後預防保養（PM）和變更控制的參考基準。例如，如果原始 OQ 記錄顯示加熱速率為 5°C/min，日後 PM 測試發現降到 3°C/min，這就觸發調查。
blocks.en: Why establish a baseline? The data generated during equipment qualification become the reference for later preventive maintenance (PM) and change control. For example, if the original OQ record shows a heating rate of 5°C/min and a later PM test finds it has dropped to 3°C/min, this triggers an investigation.

blocks.zh: Empty Chamber Temperature Distribution — 空腔溫度分布
blocks.en: Empty Chamber Temperature Distribution

blocks.zh: 「比蒸氣滅菌器更不均勻」：這是原文直接承認的現實。蒸氣滅菌器中，飽和蒸氣在腔內快速擴散，溫度均勻性通常在 ±0.5°C 以內。乾熱烘箱依靠空氣對流，均勻性可能在 ±5°C 甚至更大範圍。這也是為什麼乾熱滅菌需要使用過殺法 — 較大的溫度變異需要更大的安全裕度來補償。
blocks.en: "Less uniform than steam sterilizers": this is a reality the original text acknowledges directly. In a steam sterilizer, saturated steam spreads quickly through the chamber, and temperature uniformity is usually within ±0.5°C. A dry heat oven relies on air convection, and uniformity may be ±5°C or even wider. This is also why dry heat sterilization uses the overkill approach — the larger temperature variation requires a larger safety margin to compensate.

blocks.zh: 不需要 BI：空腔測試階段僅測物理參數（溫度分布），不需要放入生物指示劑。BI 在後續的熱穿透階段才使用。
blocks.en: BIs are not needed: the empty chamber test measures only physical parameters (temperature distribution), so no biological indicators are placed. BIs are used later, in the heat penetration phase.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務 — Tunnel vs Oven：
blocks.en: CDMO practice — tunnel vs oven:

blocks.zh: 隧道式：空腔測試關注各加熱區（Zone）的溫度梯度、輸送帶速度與溫度的對應關係
blocks.en: Tunnel: the empty chamber test focuses on the temperature gradient of each heating zone and the relationship between conveyor speed and temperature

blocks.zh: 烘箱式：關注腔內不同位置（角落、中心、上下層架）的溫度差異
blocks.en: Oven: focuses on temperature differences between locations in the chamber (corners, center, upper and lower shelves)

blocks.zh: Component Mapping — 組件佈局
blocks.en: Component Mapping

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Component Mapping
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Component Mapping

blocks.zh: Component Mapping（組件佈局）：針對單一物品的熱穿透研究，目的是找出物品內部的冷點（Cold Spot）— 即最慢達到目標溫度的位置。
blocks.en: Component mapping: a heat penetration study of a single item, whose purpose is to find the cold spot inside the item — that is, the location that is slowest to reach the target temperature.

blocks.zh: 何時需要？當物品結構複雜、有封閉空間或產品接觸面時。例如：
blocks.en: When is it needed? When the item has a complex structure, enclosed spaces, or product-contact surfaces. For example:

blocks.zh: 粉體容器 — 粉體的導熱性差，容器中心溫度可能遠低於表面
blocks.en: Powder containers — powders conduct heat poorly, so the temperature at the center of the container may be far lower than at the surface

blocks.zh: 多層包裝的金屬部件 — 鋁箔包裹的充填針頭組件
blocks.en: Multi-layer wrapped metal parts — filling needle assemblies wrapped in aluminum foil

blocks.zh: 複雜幾何形狀 — 有內腔的不銹鋼部件
blocks.en: Complex geometries — stainless steel parts with internal cavities

blocks.zh: 可轉移性：原文指出組件佈局的結果可以跨設備使用 — 因為它測的是物品本身的熱穿透特性，與特定設備無關。這對 CDMO 很有價值：一次測試即可適用於多條產線。
blocks.en: Transferability: the original text notes that component mapping results can be used across equipment, because the study measures the heat penetration characteristics of the item itself, independent of any particular equipment. This is very valuable for a CDMO: one study can apply to multiple production lines.

blocks.zh: Load Mapping — 負載佈局
blocks.en: Load Mapping

blocks.zh: Fixed Loading Pattern（固定擺放模式）：原文強調烘箱應使用固定的負載擺放模式。在 CDMO 實務中，這表示必須建立Loading SOP，配合照片或圖示明確定義每批次的擺放位置和數量。如果操作人員隨意擺放，驗證結果就沒有意義。
blocks.en: Fixed loading pattern: the original text emphasizes that an oven should use a fixed loading pattern. In CDMO practice, this means a loading SOP must be established, with photographs or diagrams that clearly define the position and quantity of items for each batch. If operators load items arbitrarily, the validation results are meaningless.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Load Mapping
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Load Mapping

blocks.zh: Load Mapping（負載佈局）：測試整個負載在設備中的溫度分布，找出負載整體的最差條件。
blocks.en: Load mapping: tests the temperature distribution of the entire load in the equipment to identify the worst-case condition for the load as a whole.

blocks.zh: Oven vs Tunnel 的差異：
blocks.en: Oven vs tunnel differences:

blocks.zh: Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑
blocks.en: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 供應商 BI vs 自製接種：原文區分了兩種使用方式：
blocks.en: Supplier BIs vs self-inoculation: the original text distinguishes two ways of using BIs:

blocks.zh: 使用供應商提供的 BI — 可直接使用供應商提供的菌數和抗性數據（D 值、菌數），無需自行測定
blocks.en: Using supplier-provided BIs — the population and resistance data provided by the supplier (D-value, population) can be used directly, without your own determination

blocks.zh: 自行接種到物品上 — 必須自行測定接種後的實際菌數和抗性，因為基質（Substrate）的改變可能影響芽孢的乾熱抗性
blocks.en: Self-inoculation onto items — you must determine the actual population and resistance after inoculation yourself, because a change of substrate may affect the dry heat resistance of the spores

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議：除非有特殊需求，建議使用供應商的商品化 BI（如 Spore Strip 或 Spore Disc），可以大幅減少測試工作量和文件負擔。
blocks.en: CDMO practical recommendation: unless there is a special need, use commercially available supplier BIs (such as spore strips or spore discs), which greatly reduce testing effort and documentation burden.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 BI Selection
blocks.en: Key Concepts: BI Selection

blocks.zh: Bacillus atrophaeus（ATCC 9372）：乾熱滅菌專用的生物指示劑菌株。選擇它的原因是其芽孢對乾熱的抗性極高，是自然環境中可能遇到的微生物中最難殺死的之一。
blocks.en: Bacillus atrophaeus (ATCC 9372): the biological indicator strain dedicated to dry heat sterilization. It was chosen because its spores have extremely high resistance to dry heat and are among the hardest of the microorganisms likely to be encountered in the natural environment to kill.

blocks.zh: BI 菌株對照表：
blocks.en: BI strain reference table:

blocks.zh: Heat Penetration & Microbiological Challenge — 熱穿透與微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Heat Penetration & Microbiological Challenge

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Validation Core
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Validation Core

blocks.zh: 熱穿透 + 微生物挑戰 = 驗證的核心：這是 PQ（Performance Qualification）的本質。兩組數據必須同時收集、交叉驗證：
blocks.en: Heat penetration + microbiological challenge = the core of validation: this is the essence of PQ (Performance Qualification). The two data sets must be collected simultaneously and cross-checked:

blocks.zh: 物理數據（Thermocouples）— 證明每個測試點都達到目標溫度和 FH
blocks.en: Physical data (thermocouples) — demonstrate that every test location reaches the target temperature and FH

blocks.zh: 微生物數據（BIs）— 證明在最差條件下，所有 BI 都被殺滅
blocks.en: Microbiological data (BIs) — demonstrate that all BIs are killed under worst-case conditions

blocks.zh: 如果物理數據顯示「達標」但 BI 未被殺滅，或物理數據「未達標」但 BI 全部死亡，都需要啟動調查。這種不一致可能暗示熱電偶位置不正確、BI 放置不當、或製程存在未知問題。
blocks.en: If the physical data show the criteria are met but a BI is not killed, or the physical data show the criteria are not met but all BIs are dead, an investigation must be started. Such an inconsistency may indicate incorrect thermocouple placement, improper BI placement, or an unknown problem in the process.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Subminimal Approach
blocks.en: Key Notes: Subminimal Approach

blocks.zh: 「略低於下限規格」（Slightly Subminimal）：這是驗證的關鍵策略。不是在正常條件下測試，而是刻意縮短時間或降低溫度到接近（但略低於）操作規格下限。如果在這種「半劑量」條件下 BI 仍然全部被殺死，就證明正常操作條件下有充分的安全裕度。
blocks.en: "Slightly subminimal": this is the key validation strategy. Rather than testing under normal conditions, you deliberately shorten the time or lower the temperature to near (but slightly below) the lower operating specification. If all BIs are still killed under this "half-dose" condition, it demonstrates an adequate safety margin under normal operating conditions.

blocks.zh: 為什麼不直接用正常條件測？因為正常條件會提供過多的致死率，可能掩蓋負載中的冷點問題。半週期測試能更敏感地檢測出溫度分布不均的問題。
blocks.en: Why not simply test under normal conditions? Because normal conditions deliver excess lethality, which may mask cold-spot problems in the load. A half-cycle test is more sensitive for detecting uneven temperature distribution.

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Maintaining Validated State
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Maintaining the Validated State

blocks.zh: 驗證不是一次性事件：通過 PQ 只是起點。原文列出了維持驗證狀態的七大要素：
blocks.en: Validation is not a one-time event: passing PQ is only the starting point. The original text lists seven elements for maintaining the validated state:

blocks.zh: Calibration（校準） — 溫度感測器的定期校準，確保讀數準確
blocks.en: Calibration — periodic calibration of temperature sensors to ensure accurate readings

blocks.zh: Physical Measurements（物理量測） — 每次運行記錄的時間–溫度數據
blocks.en: Physical measurements — time–temperature data recorded for every run

blocks.zh: Physical Integrators/Indicators（物理整合器/指示器） — 化學指示帶、溫度指示標籤等
blocks.en: Physical integrators/indicators — chemical indicator tape, temperature indicator labels, and so on

blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Control（持續製程控制） — 監控趨勢、偵測偏移
blocks.en: Ongoing process control — monitoring trends and detecting drift

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更控制） — 任何設備或製程變更都需評估對驗證狀態的影響
blocks.en: Change control — any change to equipment or process must be assessed for its impact on the validated state

blocks.zh: Preventive Maintenance（預防保養） — 按計劃執行，不能等設備故障再修
blocks.en: Preventive maintenance — performed as scheduled, not deferred until the equipment fails

blocks.zh: Periodic Reassessment & Training（定期再評估與訓練） — 週期性回顧製程表現，持續培訓操作人員
blocks.en: Periodic reassessment & training — periodic review of process performance and ongoing training of operators

blocks.zh: Change Control 的陷阱：在 CDMO 環境中，變更控制特別容易被忽略的情境包括：
blocks.en: Change control pitfalls: in a CDMO environment, situations in which change control is especially easy to overlook include:

blocks.zh: 更換西林瓶供應商 — 不同玻璃材質可能有不同的導熱特性
blocks.en: Changing the vial supplier — different glass materials may have different heat-transfer characteristics

blocks.zh: 更換 BI 批號或供應商 — 新批號的 D 值可能不同
blocks.en: Changing the BI lot or supplier — the D-value of a new lot may differ

blocks.zh: 更換加熱元件或風扇 — 影響溫度分布和空氣循環模式
blocks.en: Changing heating elements or fans — affects temperature distribution and air circulation patterns

blocks.zh: 修改負載模式 — 即使只是改變物品間距
blocks.en: Modifying the loading pattern — even a change in item spacing

blocks.zh: 以上任何變更都應觸發變更控制流程，評估是否需要重新驗證。
blocks.en: Any of the above changes should trigger the change control process to assess whether revalidation is needed.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 乾熱滅菌的適用範圍：耐熱且不適合蒸氣滅菌的物品（玻璃、金屬、粉體、非水性液體），操作溫度 160–190°C
blocks.en: Scope of dry heat sterilization: heat-resistant items that are unsuitable for steam sterilization (glass, metal, powders, non-aqueous liquids), operating at 160–190°C

blocks.zh: FH 計算：參考溫度 170°C、z 值 20°C，計算涵蓋升溫 + 保溫 + 降溫全週期的累積致死率
blocks.en: FH calculation: reference temperature 170°C and z-value 20°C; the calculation covers the cumulative lethality of the entire cycle, including heat-up, hold, and cool-down

blocks.zh: 驗證策略：因物品耐熱性高，幾乎一律採用 Overkill Method，簡化驗證需求
blocks.en: Validation strategy: because the items are highly heat resistant, the overkill method is almost always used, which simplifies validation requirements

blocks.zh: 驗證四步驟：設備確效（IQ/OQ）→ 空腔溫度分布 → 組件佈局 + 負載佈局 → 熱穿透 + 微生物挑戰（PQ）
blocks.en: Four validation steps: equipment qualification (IQ/OQ) → empty chamber temperature distribution → component mapping + load mapping → heat penetration + microbiological challenge (PQ)

blocks.zh: BI 選擇：Bacillus atrophaeus（ATCC 9372）— 乾熱滅菌專用指示菌，高度耐乾熱
blocks.en: BI selection: Bacillus atrophaeus (ATCC 9372) — the indicator organism dedicated to dry heat sterilization, highly resistant to dry heat

blocks.zh: Subminimal 測試：在略低於規格下限的條件下進行驗證，以確保正常操作有充分安全裕度
blocks.en: Subminimal testing: validation performed under conditions slightly below the lower specification limit, to ensure an adequate safety margin in normal operation

blocks.zh: 與 ⟨1228.1⟩ 的關係：除熱原隧道（≥250°C）同時達成滅菌 + 除熱原；本章僅涵蓋 160–190°C 的滅菌目的
blocks.en: Relationship to ⟨1228.1⟩: a depyrogenation tunnel (≥250°C) achieves sterilization + depyrogenation at the same time; this chapter covers only sterilization at 160–190°C

blocks.zh: 維持驗證狀態：校準、製程監控、變更控制、預防保養、定期再評估 — 七大要素缺一不可
blocks.en: Maintaining the validated state: calibration, process monitoring, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic reassessment — all seven elements are essential

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠使用除熱原隧道（300°C）處理西林瓶。為什麼這個隧道不需要另外做「乾熱滅菌驗證」？用 F<sub>H</sub> 的概念解釋。
blocks.en: Your CDMO facility uses a depyrogenation tunnel (300°C) to process vials. Why does this tunnel not need a separate "dry heat sterilization validation"? Explain using the concept of F<sub>H</sub>.

blocks.zh: 一台乾熱烘箱的空腔溫度分布測試顯示 ±8°C 的溫度變異。這是否可以接受？你會如何設定操作條件來補償這個變異？
blocks.en: The empty chamber temperature distribution test of a dry heat oven shows a temperature variation of ±8°C. Is this acceptable? How would you set the operating conditions to compensate for this variation?

blocks.zh: 某批次粉體滅菌的 PQ 結果顯示：所有熱電偶數據達到 F<sub>H</sub> ≥ 30 分鐘，但有一支 BI 呈陽性（未被殺滅）。你會如何調查這個不一致？列出至少 3 個可能原因。
blocks.en: The PQ results for a powder sterilization batch show that all thermocouple data reached F<sub>H</sub> ≥ 30 minutes, but one BI was positive (not killed). How would you investigate this inconsistency? List at least 3 possible causes.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Component Mapping 可以跨設備使用，但 Load Mapping 不行？
blocks.en: Why can component mapping be used across equipment, but load mapping cannot?
